subject.title: Feature request: Add CarPlay support to the official iOS app

question: Should OpenClaw pursue official iOS CarPlay support now, and if so which Apple category, entitlement path, and constrained Talk UX should the app target?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new official iOS app and release-signing surface, not a broken existing contract; automation cannot choose Apple category fit, App Store entitlement strategy, or the driving-safety product model.

options.title: Scope CarPlay now
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

options.title: Fold into mobile RFC
options.body: Move the idea into the mobile RFC process if maintainers want CarPlay evaluated with broader iOS/Android design direction before accepting a platform-specific issue.

options.title: Decline for now
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide CarPlay entitlement, review, or safety constraints make this out of scope for the official app in the near term.

recommendation.title: Scope CarPlay now
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical CarPlay request and ask iOS owners to define the category, entitlement plan, and minimal Talk-only UX before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion explicitly routed the feature request to Solvely-Colin, and their iOS Talk/mobile work is the closest owner path for voice-first CarPlay scoping.
